Maya Patel: Quick design review — audit log navigation accessibility. We're iterating on the audit log list (filters, date picker, role column) and need keyboard + SR behaviour nailed before next release. Thoughts? Kevin Zhou: :eyes: main asks? Maya Patel: 1) keyboard shortcuts to jump to filters / newest / date picker. 2) persistent focus when applying filters (focus stays on first result). 3) screen reader announces active filters and result count. 4) breadcrumbs for org > project > audit so context is clear. Ani R.: Agree. For SR announcements, use an `aria-live="polite"` region that updates when filters change with a short message like "Showing 12 results — filtered by Admin role, last 7 days". Samir Gupta: Also: when a user applies a role filter, focus should move to the results table header, not the first row, so keyboard users can see column controls. And ensure row selection is reachable with `Enter`. Kevin Zhou: Suggest shortcuts: `g a` to go to audit, `f` to open filter pane, `n` for newest. Keep it discoverable (help modal and tooltip in header). Maya Patel: Love shorthand. Can we keep shortcuts off by default for screen readers? Or make them configurable in settings? Ani R.: Shortcuts don't break SR if implemented with `aria-hidden` on hint elements, but we should provide an option in preferences and announce shortcut availability in the help modal. DesignBot: New prototype uploaded: https://redwood.design/protos/audit-keyboard-v2.png Maya Patel: Quick a11y nit: filter chips need focus styles and visible focus ring; high contrast when active. Also ensure color is not the only state for selected chips. Samir Gupta: Good catch. Also add ARIA label on the date picker like `aria-label="Audit date range"` and ensure it's keyboard-navigable (month nav buttons tabbable). Ani R.: Example aria-live snippet for the filter update: ```
Showing 0 results
// JS: document.getElementById('audit-announcer').textContent = `Showing ${count} results — filtered by ${filtersText}`; ``` Kevin Zhou: One more: keyboard users should be able to jump to the table via `Skip to results` link that becomes visible on focus. That helps customers using keyboard only. Maya Patel: OK action items: Ani to draft aria-live copy and edge-case messages (no results, pagination). Kevin to spec shortcuts + help modal. Samir to verify tab order and datepicker tabbability. I'll follow up with a tiny prototype update. :thumbsup: DesignBot: Created a checklist: a11y annnouncer, focus states, shortcuts spec, skip link, datepicker tabbable. Maya Patel: Thanks team — will sync on PR review tomorrow. :pray:
